Team bonus

Source: Megatix › Reports › Completed Orders Detail for the five 2027 XXL events, exported each morning. Web checkouts only; each order is dated by its Megatix order time.
Channels follow the rows in the DAILY SALES sheets (Promoters, Emails & Texts, Socials, Local DJs, Affiliates, TikTok/YouTube, Ads, Untracked), except that Website direct (the WEBSITE link plus the BACKSTAGE10 pop-up code) is shown on its own rather than inside Ads and Emails & Texts, and Call centre (the FRIEND codes) is shown on its own rather than inside Socials. VIP upgrades are counted separately and not added to tickets sold.
